category: browser app builder with a coding agent

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 1M AI tokens a month and a 300K daily token limit, 333K web requests a month, public and private projects, website hosting on a bolt.host URL; the Standard agent only
free_tier.notes: monthly tokens reset on the 1st of the calendar month; the daily 300K does not carry over; direct edits in Code view use no tokens, so the daily cap leaves manual editing available

per_object_cap.stated: file upload limit 10MB on the Free plan

retention.stated: not applicable: a coding agent meters tokens, not stored bytes

egress.terms: published hosting limits for a project on the Free plan: up to 10 GB of bandwidth and 333,333 web requests a month, with the site offline for the rest of the month when exceeded; the limits cannot be raised on Free

interface_detail: a browser application at bolt.new; no public API, CLI or SDK. A GitHub repository can be synced to a project, which does not drive the agent from outside
tooling: browser only: the user prompts the agent in the Bolt web app, which runs on WebContainers; no client, API, CLI or SDK exists to automate it
chaining: the token allowance buys prompt-driven builds with hosting on bolt.host in the same account; code can be synced to a GitHub repository and built on elsewhere. No endpoint takes the tokens, so they cannot feed an external agent

limits.value: 1M AI tokens a month, reset on the 1st of the calendar month; unused tokens do not roll over
300K tokens a day, separate from the monthly cap; the daily allowance does not carry over
333K web requests a month and 10 GB of bandwidth for hosted sites; the site goes offline for the rest of the month when exceeded

limits_note: the daily 300K cap binds before the monthly 1M on a heavy day; Code view edits use no tokens
binding_note: 1M tokens a month with a 300K daily ceiling; the daily ceiling stops a long session first

identity_cost.detail: Free sign-up is with Google, GitHub, or an email address, a username and a password; an email sign-up is confirmed by email before sign-in. The pricing page says no credit card is required. A phone step is not described on the pages read

reliability_note: Free-plan tokens do not roll over, and a project goes offline for the rest of the month after 333,333 web requests or 10 GB of bandwidth; the Free plan includes only the Standard agent, not Max or Forge
confidence_note: the allowance, the daily cap and the sign-up steps are quoted from first-party pricing and help-center pages read on 2026-11-02. The underlying model of the Standard agent is not published. Nothing was measured behind a sign-up.
